title: Jeremiah Cast into the Cistern

questions.question: Some officials heard Jeremiah telling the people that anyone who stayed in the city would die, but anyone who went out to the Chaldeans would have his life as a prize of war. What did these officials ask the king to do to Jeremiah?
options: Let this man be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: Let this man be put to death
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:4 (ESV): "Then the officials said to the king, 'Let this man be put to death, for he is weakening the hands of the soldiers who are left in this city...'"

questions.question: King Zedekiah replied to the officials, "Behold, he is in your hands, for the king can do nothing... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:5 (ESV): "King Zedekiah said, 'Behold, he is in your hands, for the king can do nothing against you.'"

questions.question: Where did they cast Jeremiah?
options: Into the cistern of Malchiah, in the court of the guard
Into a prison cell in the temple
Over the wall of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Into the cistern of Malchiah, in the court of the guard
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:6 (ESV): "So they took Jeremiah and cast him into the cistern of Malchiah, the king's son, which was in the court of the guard, letting Jeremiah down by ropes."

questions.question: What was at the bottom of the cistern into which Jeremiah sank?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:6 (ESV): "And there was no water in the cistern, but only mud, and Jeremiah sank in the mud."

questions.question: Who heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern?
options: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a eunuch in the king's house
questions.correctAnswer: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a eunuch in the king's house
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:7 (ESV): "When Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a eunuch who was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern..."

questions.question: Ebed-melech told the king: "My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they did to Jeremiah the prophet... and he will... right where he is because of the famine"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:9 (ESV): "and he will die of hunger right where he is, for there is no bread left in the city."

questions.question: How many men did the king command Ebed-melech to take to lift Jeremiah out of the cistern before he died?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:10 (ESV): "Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, 'Take thirty men with you from here, and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.'"

questions.question: What did Ebed-melech throw down to Jeremiah to put under his armpits so the ropes wouldn't chafe him?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:11-12 (ESV): "...took from there old rags and worn-out clothes, which he let down to Jeremiah in the cistern by ropes... 'Put the rags and clothes between your armpits and the ropes.'"

questions.question: After being rescued from the cistern, where did Jeremiah remain?
options: In the court of the guard
questions.correctAnswer: In the court of the guard
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:13 (ESV): "So they drew Jeremiah up with ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard."

questions.question: King Zedekiah called Jeremiah to the third entrance of the temple and asked him a question. What did Jeremiah fear Zedekiah would do if he told him the truth?
options: Throw him back in the cistern
Both put him to death and not listen
questions.correctAnswer: Both put him to death and not listen
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:15 (ESV): "Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, 'If I tell you, will you not surely put me to death? And if I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.'"

questions.question: What did Zedekiah swear to Jeremiah secretly?
options: "As the Lord lives... I will not put you to death or deliver you into the hand of these men who seek your life."
"I will protect you from the Chaldeans."
questions.correctAnswer: "As the Lord lives... I will not put you to death or deliver you into the hand of these men who seek your life."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:16 (ESV): "King Zedekiah swore secretly to Jeremiah, 'As the Lord lives... I will not put you to death or deliver you into the hand of these men who seek your life.'"

questions.question: Jeremiah told Zedekiah: "If you will surrender to the officials of the king of Babylon, then your life shall be spared... But if you do not surrender... this city shall be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall... it with fire, and you shall not... from their hand."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:17-18 (ESV): "they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape from their hand."

questions.question: What was Zedekiah afraid of, as a reason for not wanting to surrender to Babylon?
options: He was afraid of the Judeans who had already deserted to the Chaldeans, lest he be handed over to them and abused
He was afraid Nebuchadnezzar would flay him alive
He was afraid the priests would curse him
He was afraid of losing his wealth
questions.correctAnswer: He was afraid of the Judeans who had already deserted to the Chaldeans, lest he be handed over to them and abused
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:19 (ESV): "King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, 'I am afraid of the Judeans who have deserted to the Chaldeans, lest I be handed over to them and they abuse me.'"

questions.question: If Zedekiah did not surrender, Jeremiah warned him that all his... and... would be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:23 (ESV): "All your wives and your sons shall be led out to the Chaldeans, and you yourself shall not escape from their hand,"

questions.question: The king ordered Jeremiah not to let anyone know the true subject of their conversation. If the officials asked, what was Jeremiah supposed to say he had been petitioning the king for?
options: Not to send him back to Jonathan's house to die there
For more food in the guardhouse
For a blanket against the cold
Permission to leave the city to buy land
questions.correctAnswer: Not to send him back to Jonathan's house to die there
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 38:26 (ESV): "you shall say to them, 'I was presenting my plea to the king not to send me back to the house of Jonathan to die there.'"

key_verse_text: So they took Jeremiah and cast him into the cistern of Malchiah, the king's son, which was in the court of the guard, letting Jeremiah down by ropes. And there was no water in the cistern, but only mud, and Jeremiah sank in the mud.
